mediaConcurrencyUpdate.interpretation: The direct baseline and concurrent samples are observations of one title/episode with changing network conditions. Independent HTTP/1.1 range connections, a short initial block, resolved media URL reuse and direct public-player resolution were evaluated as a combined change. This is not an isolated measurement of thread count. The mgnacg sample still buffers substantially; parallel downloads do not eliminate upstream bandwidth limits. Concurrency is enabled only for mgnacg in deployed WEX. xfdmnext concurrency was a temporary device test, not a deployed setting.

assessment.note: The updated upstream rule restored search/detail and video decoding, but the measured sample still contained substantial buffering. Continuous playback is not established. An earlier first-line run stalled, and a separate second-line attempt failed with an invalid Base64 decoding error; the originating field was not isolated. No all-line reliability claim.
